crossRefs.note: He said to them, “This is that which Yahweh has spoken, ‘Tomorrow is a solemn rest, a holy Sabbath to Yahweh. Bake that…
On the seventh day, some of the people went out to gather, and they found none.
Yahweh said to Moses, “How long do you refuse to keep my commandments and my laws?
“Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.
‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be a holy day for you, a Sabbath of solemn rest to…
You shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations on the Sabbath day.’ ”

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: While the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.
translations.bsb: While the Israelites were in the wilderness, a man was found gathering wood on the Sabbath day.
translations.kjv: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day.
translations.asv: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks upon the sabbath day.
